findings.evidence: Mathlib IsManifold/Basic.lean:833–842 provides `LEInfty` instances for `ℕ∞` and `ℕ` casts, numerals, `0` and `1`. Tau Ceti BumpFunction.lean:40 `contMDiff_of_isManifold {n} [ENat.LEInfty n]`, Contact/Levi.lean:191 and others use the class. The PR's own LocalFrame proof has to write `let : ENat.LEInfty n := ⟨hn⟩`. The PR examples call `exists_fin_spanning_contMDiffSection (by norm_num)` at `n = 0` and `... hS le_rfl (by norm_num)` at `n = 1`, which shows the `by rfl` default fails at finite orders.
findings.fix: Replace the explicit `hn_top`/`hn` bound with an instance argument `[ENat.LEInfty n]` (or put it in the section `variable` block) in all four statements. Drop the hand-built `let : ENat.LEInfty n := ⟨hn⟩` where the instance can flow through, and remove the `(by norm_num)` arguments from the examples.
findings.issue: `exists_fin_spanning_contMDiffSection (hn : n ≤ ∞ := by rfl)`: the default only works when `n = ∞`. At finite orders, the case this PR targets, callers must pass a proof by hand, unlike the Mathlib/Tau Ceti convention for this bound. Same problem at Generic.lean:311 (`exists_contMDiffSection_forall_ne_zero_of_finrank_lt`), Generic.lean:329 (`exists_contMDiffSection_regular_finite_zero_of_finrank_eq`) and Generic.lean:431 (`exists_contMDiffSection_regular_finite_zero_forall_mem_ne_zero`).

summary: The order generalization is done in place with no compatibility layer, and the arithmetic helper is now correctly placed as `TauCeti.toNat_add_one_le_of_nonpos`. The new public `n ≤ ∞` bound is an explicit `:= by rfl` hypothesis instead of the canonical `[ENat.LEInfty n]` class, so the default fails at every finite order and callers must supply the proof by hand.
